_about: Vostok Radar Station v0.21: the background mountains meet the terrain. The 0.21d project places background_mountains 0.11 m above terrain_all (render_visuals position y 0.11), while the mountains' inner edge is the terrain's outer edge vertex for vertex (within 0.6 mm in model space); the 11 cm step between them is a slit through which the sky shows as a bright line along the hills at the map's edge. At y 0 the two meshes meet; they do not overlap anywhere, so nothing z-fights. Every live project of the map: day_2, day_4 and day_8 (Free for All, copied from day_4 by ffa-projects-1).
